title: proclesia bracteata
intro: Proclesia bracteata, commonly known as the "Indian Tickle Me Not" or "Tickle Me Not", is a plant species native to India and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Proclesia bracteata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of Proclesia bracteata as a medicinal plant.
